text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of girls enrolled in primary school
Comparing net and gross enrollment ratios for girls in primary education. Net enrollment shows the share of
girls of primary school age (typically 6–11 years) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all girls
regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of girls of the same age group.
